ops.title: Investigate repository metadata cache identity for indirect Git includes
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccn_c1_case_peer. Separate existing path from direct ship-context task a251b74aec9ec1910c03775ed0a26b8342b83f25. Source-only counterexample: for one root, otherwise equal contexts with GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 / GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=include.path and distinct GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 files map to the same repoRoutingContext/cache key, because only direct URL/pushURL/rewrite keys are selected. If those included files supply distinct remote identity, the cached result can remain stale. No live Git/gh behavior was exercised, so actual resolver impact, affected population and repair/installation are UNKNOWN. Evidence: FE/ccx-ship-repository-context-independent-source-review.json SHA138e4e6d6e8ae15c2ad7083a5c9a156a34642ee53b04ce5aeb7b86bdb23730f7; source packet81cabdb7f6b2d376e688e70dc98a44425733a761cb05bf32cf649a9f3de3f7e2. Root explicitly keeps direct GH_REPO/URL/pushURL/rewrite delivery unblocked; no unsupported-config claim or all-caller redesign is authorized by this record. Next executable step: add the smallest isolated CI fixture using two private Git includes and the existing recorded GH boundary to establish or exonerate an actual stale repository identity; return concrete contract options before broadening transport resolution.

ops.text: A minimal private Git/include regression establishes or exonerates the stale identity mechanism without real foreign PR writes; retain exact source and CI evidence.

If confirmed, obtain the bounded resolver/invalidation contract, implement with existing helpers and independent review/full CI, then normal merge/release/supported install plus installed private affected verification.
If exonerated, close through normal task flow with the exact resolver/source/CI evidence, preserving the source key-collision observation.
